description: The team flow of smooth-backlog-cli 174c76d expressed as data: a lead splits a work item, members refine, a reviewed refinement is claimed, worked, reviewed in two stages and closed.

completeness.name: definition_of_done
ignore_lines: ^[ \t]*(?:Claimed by|Released by|Review started by|Review by \S+ stale|Refinement started by|Refinement review requested by|WAITING |WAIT DONE |DECISION |CHUNK |ESTIMATE:)[^\n]*$

waiting.record: WAIT DONE <now> (next step on the item)

claim.records: Claimed by <actor> at <now> repository=<repository> branch=<branch> cwd=<cwd><forced>

reassign-review.records:
## Review reassigned by <actor> from <reviewer_if_active> to <value> at <now>

<reason>

session.end_text: 🛑 <agent>: END THE SESSION NOW. Reply with text only and make no further tool call; your next task starts in a fresh session.

texts.refine_how: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --set-review-refs <review document>,.. / --set-depends-on <ids|none> / --set-estimate <minutes> --set-complexity low|medium|high [--set-layer 1-5|process] / --append '## Definition of done\n- [ ] <checkable line>'

refusals.team_not_configured: team <team> is not configured in the backlog configuration
refusals.step_not_defined: <step> is not a step of workflow <workflow> (team <team>); the team's behaviour file defines its steps
refusals.status_flag: backlog team update takes no --status: the status of a team item moves by its steps (--claim, --request-review, --start-review, --review, --close)
refusals.one_step: one team-work step at a time (got <flags>)
refusals.empty_flag_value: <item>: --<step> needs the dependent (an empty value records nothing)
refusals.not_team_item: <item> belongs to no team: use backlog update, or bind it with backlog team update <item> --team <team> --set-team <team>
refusals.other_team: the item belongs to team <item_team>, not to this session's team <team>
refusals.outside_scope: this item belongs to repository <repository> branch <branch>, but this team session is bound to <bound> (TEAM_REPOSITORY/TEAM_BRANCH): a team works only on its own items; read other scopes with backlog team query --scope, never claim or change them
refusals.caller_not_actor: you are <caller> (BACKLOG_AGENT): a member acts only as itself, not as <actor>; only the team lead (<lead>) takes or gives another agent's work (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <lead> --reassign <agent> --reason "<why>")
refusals.create_status_flag: --status cannot be combined with --team: a team item starts in its own first status
refusals.session_branch: --branch <value>: this team session is bound to branch <bound> (TEAM_BRANCH)
refusals.pop_caller: you are <caller> (BACKLOG_AGENT): team pop answers only for yourself, not for <agent>
refusals.session_ended: <actor>: this session handed its item on and ended; a fresh session takes the next step
refusals.finished_claim: <item>: status is <status>; a finished item cannot be claimed
refusals.lead_claims_split: <item>: the team lead (<actor>) never claims an item of its team's split; a member claims it
refusals.claim_awaiting_decision_hint: ; nobody claims it, --force included (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <you> --decision "<answer>" first)
refusals.refine_first_hint: ; refine it first: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <you> --refine-start
refusals.claimed_by_other: <item>: claimed by <holder> since <claimed_at>; message <holder> or pick another item
refusals.active_items: <item>: <actor> holds <n> active item(s): <list>; pull new work only when every item you hold waits (review requested, or backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <actor> --waiting "<what>"); --force overrides
refusals.limit: <item>: the <level> work-in-progress limit<of> is <limit> and <count> item(s) are in progress (<held>); finish one first<hint>
refusals.limit_hint: , or the team lead lifts the limit for this item: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <lead> --wip-override "<reason>"
refusals.recheck_active_items: <actor> holds <n> active item(s): <list>; pull new work only when every item you hold waits; --force overrides
refusals.dep_handoff_missing: done, hand-off missing: the producer has not recorded a hand-off for this item; it records one and the team lead accepts it
refusals.dep_handoff_unaccepted: done, hand-off unaccepted: the team lead has not accepted the producer's hand-off
refusals.dep_handoff_stale: done, hand-off stale: the last receipt does not match the current hand-off record: the producer re-recorded it after the last receipt (an acceptance or a rejection), or the record's digest does not match its own fields; the producer records a clean hand-off when the record is broken, and the team lead must accept the current record
refusals.dep_handoff_rejected: done, hand-off rejected: the team lead rejected the producer's hand-off; the team lead must accept the current record (or the producer records a new one and the lead accepts that)
refusals.finished_release: <item>: status is <status>; a finished item cannot be released into the queue
refusals.release_other: <item>: <actor> cannot release <value>'s item: only the team lead (<lead>) does, with --reason "<why>"
refusals.reassign_not_lead: <item>: --reassign --by <the team lead>: only the lead (<lead>) gives one agent's item to another (got <actor_or_none>)
refusals.reassign_finished: <item>: status is <status>; a finished item is not reassigned
refusals.reassign_nobody: <item>: nobody holds the item: the agent claims it (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --claim)
refusals.handoff_not_holder: <item>: a hand-off is recorded by the claimer: the item is claimed by <holder_or_nobody>, not by <actor>
refusals.handoff_not_dependent: <item>: dependent '<value>' is not one of this item's dependents (<dependents>)
refusals.handoff_no_record: <item>: no hand-off record for dependent '<value>'; the producer records it first (--handoff)
refusals.handoff_checks_empty: <item>: the acceptance of a hand-off needs its checks (--checks "<text>")
refusals.handoff_review_not_passed: <item>: the producer's review has not passed (status <status>); the hand-off is accepted only after it
refusals.handoff_no_commit: <item>: the hand-off record for dependent '<value>' has no commit; a hand-off without its commit on record is not accepted (--handoff-commit <sha>)
refusals.handoff_accept_not_lead: <item>: a hand-off is accepted by the team lead (<lead>), not by <actor>
refusals.handoff_reject_not_lead: <item>: a hand-off is rejected by the team lead (<lead>), not by <actor>
refusals.handoff_reason_empty: <item>: the rejection of a hand-off needs its reason (--reason "<text>")
refusals.request_review_no_note: <item>: --request-review needs --note "<what to review: commits, deployed evidence>"
refusals.request_review_in_review: <item>: <reviewer> is reviewing it since <review_started>: wait for the verdict; the team lead hands a stale review on (--reassign-review)
refusals.request_review_not_holder: <item>: <holder> holds it: only the holder, or the team lead, asks for its review (not <actor>)
refusals.self_review: <item>: <actor>: the same session cannot review its own work; a new session may
refusals.self_review_target: <item>: <value>: the same session cannot review its own work; a new session may
refusals.no_review_requested_first: <item>: no review is requested (status <status>); the agent working on it runs --request-review first
refusals.review_taken: <item>: in review by <reviewer> since <review_started>; review another item<stale_hint>
refusals.review_taken_short: <item>: in review by <reviewer> since <review_started>; review another item
refusals.stale_hint: (the review is stale: the team lead hands it on with backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <lead> --reassign-review <agent> --reason "<why>")
refusals.review_cite_refs: <item>: --comments must cite at least one of the item's review_refs (<review_refs>): they are its definition of done and the review document
refusals.review_author_session: <item>: <actor> reviews in the author session: a review runs in a fresh session
refusals.reassign_review_not_lead: <item>: --reassign-review --by <the team lead>: only the lead (<lead>) hands a review on (got <actor_or_none>)
refusals.review_no_work_commit: team <team>: the review rules need a work commit; request the review from the repository (--request-review)
refusals.review_lookup_failed: team <team>: the commit lookup failed (<reason_text>); fail closed: request the review again
refusals.review_later_work: team <team>: the item has new work after its last review request; request the review again
refusals.review_rule_not_met: team <team>: review rule not met - <need> pass(es) by <reviewers_text> on the current work commit needed, <have> recorded (teams.json)
refusals.refine_claimed: <item>: claimed by <holder>: the work item itself is refined and split by the team lead, not refined here
refusals.refine_other: <item>: <refiner> is refining it since <refine_started>; refine another item
refusals.refine_lead_first_round: <item>: a member, not the team lead, refines in the first round (spec section 4); the lead re-refines only an item an owner decision returned to it
refusals.refine_wrong_status: <item>: only an item of a team in stage refining is refined (team <team>, status <status>)
refusals.rr_request_not_lead: <item>: --request-refinement-review --by <the team lead>: the lead (<lead>) sends a refined item to the refinement review (got <actor_or_none>)
refusals.rr_request_not_refined: <item>: only a refined item goes to the refinement review (status <status>)
refusals.rr_not_reviewer: <item>: --refinement-review --by <actor>: the refinement of team <team> is reviewed by a member of <teams> (teams.json)
refusals.rr_no_comments: <item>: --refinement-review needs --comments "<the reviewer's findings, and its thread or session id>"
refusals.decision_not_before_ready: <item>: only a team item before ready waits for an owner decision (team <team>, status <status>)
refusals.decision_no_question: <item>: --request-decision needs the question: what, why, how it came up, the options and a recommendation
refusals.close_not_holder: <item>: only the claimer (<holder>) closes it, else the team lead (<lead>); not <actor>
refusals.close_unheld: <item>: nobody holds this item of team <team>: the team lead (<lead>) closes it; not <actor>
refusals.close_gate_missing_hint: A hand-off is required: run `backlog update --help` for details.
refusals.close_gate_none_record: DEPENDENCY_HANDOFF: NONE (no dependent items; checked by the CLI at close)
refusals.wip_override_not_lead: <item>: only the team lead (<lead>) lifts the team and agent work-in-progress limits for an item (got <actor_or_nobody>; --by <lead>)
refusals.set_team_keep: <item>: an item in a refinement or work status keeps a team (the stages are team work); set another team instead
refusals.edit_frozen: <item>: in stage refinement-review the item stays as the reviewer reads it; a changes verdict returns it to refining
refusals.edit_exclusive: <item>: --<step> records the verdict alone; change the item first and have it reviewed again
refusals.edit_before_ready: <item>: team <team> item in status <status>: before stage ready only its refinement steps run (<flags> refused)
refusals.edit_lead_refining: <item>: a member, not the team lead, refines in the first round (spec section 4); the lead edits an item in stage refining only as its refiner
refusals.edit_incomplete_not_lead: <item>: incomplete item, missing <missing>: only the team lead (<lead>) refines it, not <actor>
refusals.edit_incomplete: <item>: incomplete item, missing <missing>: in a team nobody claims, reviews or works it (<flags> refused); the team lead refines it only: <how>
refusals.user_update: use backlog team update: a team item is changed only there, and its status moves by its team steps
refusals.user_replan: use backlog team update --replan: <list> <belong> to a team, and a team item takes its place in the queue only there
refusals.user_archive_unfinished: use backlog team update: <item> belongs to a team and is not closed, and a team item is archived only after its team close (--force does not change that)
refusals.user_import_higher: import --higher: <list> <belong> to a team, and a team item takes its place in the queue only with backlog team update --priority; nothing was moved (import without --higher moves them)
refusals.user_clean: clean: <list> <belong> to a team, and no command deletes a team item (there is no team door for it); nothing was removed
refusals.user_split: item <item> belongs to team <item_team>: a split of a team's item is made by backlog team new

instructions.review_continue: continue your review (started <review_started>): review the work of <holder_or_author><refs_note>, then backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --review pass|changes --comments "<findings>"
instructions.review_start: start the review: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --start-review; then review the work of <holder_or_author><refs_note>, then backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --review pass|changes --comments "<findings>"
instructions.refs_note: ; load its review_refs first: <review_refs> (the review-documents repository) and cite one in --comments
instructions.continue_work: you hold it: <claim_first>keep working and record each step in the item (backlog update <item> --append "..."), then write the reviewer handoff and --request-review - the team's review rules must be met before the close<dod>
instructions.continue_passed_rules_pending: <claim_first><review_refusal>: request the next review (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --request-review <reviewer> --note "<the commit>"); after the rules are met, close <seq>
instructions.claim_first: first claim it as <agent> (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --claim), then
instructions.dod: ; definition of done: <review_refs> (the review-documents repository: load them before working)
instructions.refine_continue: you are refining <seq>: complete its team fields and definition of done (<how>), then backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --refine-done --note "<what you refined>"
instructions.refine_start: refine it before anyone works on it: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --refine-start, complete its team fields and definition of done (<how>), then backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --refine-done --note "<what you refined>"
instructions.claimed: claimed for <agent>: start the work and record each step in the item<dod>
instructions.foreign_wait_member: the work here waits on <first>: do that first in <repositories>: tell the team lead
instructions.foreign_wait_lead: the work here waits on <first>: do that first in <repositories>: end the session here; the team is started in that repository
instructions.chunk_item: do one small chunk (<= 10 min) of it<where>, then backlog update <item> --append "CHUNK <time> <what> <result>"
instructions.chunk_generic: no item fits you: do one small chunk (<= 10 min) of refinement or tests on the open items of your team <team> and append "CHUNK <time> <what> <result>" to the item you touched
instructions.lead_close_work_item: <claim_first>every item of team <team> is done: close <seq> (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --close --summary "<outcome>")
instructions.lead_close_work_item_review: <claim_first>every item of team <team> is done: have <seq> reviewed first (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --request-review any --note "<the items and their evidence>") - the team's review rules must be met before the close
instructions.lead_refinement_review: have the refinement of <seqs> reviewed before anyone works on them: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --request-refinement-review for each refined one; have a reviewer of the team's refinement_review rule (teams.json) give a pass or changes verdict per item against the team standard (the item's review documents); then record each verdict: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <reviewer> --refinement-review pass|changes --comments "<findings; thread or session id>"
instructions.lead_stale_review: the review of <seq> by <reviewer> is stale (started <review_started>): hand it on: backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --reassign-review <member> --reason "<why>"
instructions.lead_work_item: you hold <item>, the work item of team <team>: refine it, and split it only when it is too big for one member (backlog new --split-from <item> --depends-on <ids|none> --estimate <minutes> per item; they start in stage refining for the members); a refined work item is an ordinary item any member may claim; then run backlog team pop --team <team> --agent <agent> for each next step
instructions.lead_refine_incomplete: refine <seq>, never action it: set <missing> (<how>); an incomplete item means the backlog was not filled properly: once complete, record the gap in the item (backlog update <item> --append "GAP: ...")
instructions.lead_busy: your team works on <n> item(s) (<seqs>): end your turn now with a text-only reply and no tool call; do not poll, the dispatcher wakes you
instructions.plan_respond: the review by <reviewer> asked for changes (<reviewed_at>): <claim_first>read its findings in the item, fix them, record each step (backlog update <item> --append "..."), then backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --request-review any --note "<what changed>"
instructions.plan_review_request: <claim_first><review_refusal>: request the next review (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --request-review <reviewer> --note "<the commit>") and close after the rules are met
instructions.plan_claim: claim exactly this item (planned for you; do not pop for another): backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <agent> --claim, then start the work and record each step in the item<dod>
instructions.close_now: ➡️  CLOSE NOW: <holder> closes it (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <holder> --close --summary "<outcome>"); if the claimer has not, the team lead closes it when available (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <lead> --close --summary ...)
instructions.close_now_unheld: ➡️  CLOSE NOW: nobody holds it: the team lead closes it (backlog team update <item> --team <team> --agent <lead> --close --summary "<outcome>")
instructions.completion_ender: the team lead re-evaluates the order (backlog update --replan, --priority); not you
